## VS Code port

| Upstream | Here |
| --- | --- |
| `scripts/hitl-loop.template.sh` | A human-in-the-loop round through the VS Code question tool. The Bash script is not shipped. |
| `git bisect run` | Asks the user first, because the always-on instructions forbid switching revisions. |
| Shell loops | Run in VS Code terminals in the user's shell, with servers in a background terminal. Cleanup stops them. |
| Show hypotheses, don't block | Posted in chat, because the question tool blocks. |
